_comment: Canonical typed read models for the passkey-scoped observability read API (/api/v1/observe). These are browser-session-authenticated, user-scoped, read-only projections. Controllers derive user_id from the validated cookie, ignore caller-supplied identity, cap limits, use stable cursors, and return canonical typed JSON. All models exclude null fields on the wire.

agent_state_projection._description: Current lifecycle state of a single agent persona in the roster. Combines the static persona registry projection with the current agent-state snapshot.

agent_id.description: Stable agent identifier matching the persona registry

role.description: Agent role or persona (e.g. triage, sage, dash, auditor, warden, scribe, judge)

run_id.description: Owning run identifier when the agent is bound to a run

task_id.description: Active task identifier when the agent is executing a task

model.description: Model identifier when the agent is configured with a model

throughput.description: Tokens-per-second measurement. Unavailable until a real measured source exists.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last status observation

overview_counters._description: Bounded overview counters for the dashboard header. Each counter carries a freshness label so the frontend can show stale or unavailable states honestly.

agents_running.description: Count of agents in active states as defined by the projection contract

tasks_in_queue.description: Count of tasks awaiting execution. Queue semantics are defined by the projection contract, not inferred from incomplete replay history.

success_rate.description: Aggregate success-rate measurement with metric ID, version, denominator, and verification status. Omitted when no eval or run aggregate exists.

overview_measurements._description: Resource and throughput measurements for the dashboard. Each card uses ObservedMeasurement with explicit status. Cards remain unavailable until a real host telemetry collector exists.

total_throughput.description: Aggregate tokens-per-second across matching windows and units. Omitted when no measured source exists.

cpu.description: Host CPU utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

ram.description: Host RAM utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

vram.description: GPU VRAM utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

disk.description: Host disk utilization from a target-scoped collector. Omitted when no collector exists.

run_summary._description: Paginated read-only run summary owned by the authenticated user. Uses stable run IDs, kinds, timestamps, terminal status, and evidence/receipt indicators.

has_receipts.description: Whether the run has at least one governance receipt

evidence_count.description: Number of evidence-safe artifacts associated with the run

run_task._description: A single task within a run detail projection.

owning_agent.description: Agent identifier owning this task when assigned

evidence_safe_link._description: An evidence-safe link in a run detail projection. Links to allowlisted download artifacts only; never exposes restricted prompts, model outputs, or governed evidence.

artifact_id.description: Download artifact identifier in the allowlisted catalog

label.description: Human-readable label for the evidence artifact

run_detail._description: Typed run detail projection with tasks and evidence-safe links. Owned by the authenticated user.

evidence_safe_links.description: Evidence-safe links to allowlisted download artifacts

eval_summary._description: Paginated eval run projection. Uses manifest role-to-model mappings and registered metrics with honest verification labels.

verification_status.description: Honest verification boundary label. Never 'verified' until the complete verifier exists.

metric_count.description: Number of registered metrics in the projection

published_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted disclosure-safe projection. Omitted when no projection is published.

eval_metric_summary._description: A single registered metric in an eval detail projection.

eval_detail._description: Typed eval detail projection with manifest-safe identity, arm/model information, aggregate metrics, status, and verification boundary.

model_id.description: Model identifier from the manifest role-to-model mapping. Omitted when not available.

model_provider.description: Model provider from the manifest. Omitted when not available.

download_artifact._description: An allowlisted generated public-safe artifact in the download catalog. Has fixed content type, byte size, SHA-256 hash, privacy classification, and authenticated download URL.

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identifier used in the download URL path

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact content for integrity verification

privacy_classification.description: Disclosure classification. Only public_safe artifacts appear in the browser catalog.

source_run_id.description: Run that produced this artifact when applicable

download_url.description: Authenticated download URL path relative to the Gateway base URL

observe_page._description: Pagination wrapper for paginated observe API responses. Uses stable cursors and bounded page sizes.

items.description: Page items. The item type depends on the endpoint (run_summary, eval_summary, download_artifact).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omitted when there are no more results.

limit.description: Page size applied to this response

observe_bootstrap_snapshot._description: One bounded initial snapshot for first paint. Contains agents, active run, overview counters, recent runs, latest eval summaries, measurements, and download metadata. SSE provides incremental change notifications after the snapshot.

agents.description: Agent roster with current state snapshots

active_run.description: Currently active run for the authenticated user. Omitted when no run is active.

recent_runs.description: Bounded list of recent run summaries

latest_evals.description: Bounded list of latest eval summaries
